subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class V

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class V English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Santoor (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Santoor, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

outcomes.text: Rearranges jumbled sentences and finds errors.
Uses collective, abstract and concrete nouns, and masculine and feminine forms.
Uses kinds of pronouns, including possessive pronouns.
Uses the simple past, present perfect and past perfect.
Uses adverbs of time and frequency, prepositions and linkers.
Uses compound words, prefixes, contractions and words that sound alike.
Uses words of the same and opposite meaning.
